text: Computer vision is a branch of artificial intelligence that enables computers to understand and interpret the visual world. It involves tasks like image recognition, where the system identifies objects or people in photos, and object detection, which locates and labels different items within an image. These technologies have many practical applications. For example, in self-driving cars, computer vision helps the vehicle recognize traffic signs, pedestrians, and other cars to navigate safely. It is also used in medical imaging, security surveillance, and smartphone features like face unlocking. As the technology improves, computer vision is becoming increasingly important in our daily lives.
